## Building a model

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "make models rebuilds only a model whose design, sizes or built files differ from its build record."
flowchart TD
  start["make models"] --> each{"for each models/&lt;slug&gt;/&lt;slug&gt;.sc"}
  each --> hash{"the design, its sizes and its built files<br/>match build.json?"}
  hash -- yes --> skip["left alone"]
  hash -- "no, or no build yet" --> run["solidcraft-cli run → &lt;slug&gt;.stl"]
  run --> snap["solidcraft-cli snapshot → &lt;slug&gt;.png"]
  snap --> evaluate["solidcraft-cli eval → &lt;slug&gt;.eval.json"]
  evaluate --> sized["for each extra size in model.yml:<br/>a parameter change → &lt;slug&gt;-&lt;size&gt;.stl"]
  sized --> record["build.json: every file's sha256, the sizes, the CLI's version"]
```

## Checks and the deploy

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "CI runs on every push; only main deploys."
flowchart LR
  push["a push"] --> tests["tests job<br/>make test · lint<br/>models-check · privacy"]
  push --> leaks["leaks job<br/>gitleaks over every commit, merges included"]
  push --> site["site job<br/>make docs: render, offsite check, lychee"]
  tests --> pagesjob{"on main?"}
  leaks --> pagesjob
  site --> pagesjob
  pagesjob -- yes --> deploy["pages job<br/>deploy to GitHub Pages"]
```

## The rail, part by part

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "The grow-light rail, from the wall to the light: what holds what. Solid: built. Dashed: planned, labelled with the phase that brings it."
flowchart LR
  wall["the wall<br/>a stud, or toggle bolts"]
  feet["rail-feet<br/>both screwed behind the rail, under caps;<br/>the rail screwed down in the bottom cup<br/>Phase 2"]
  rail["the rail<br/>a dowel, up to 48 in"]
  carrier["rail-carrier<br/>a U pushed on from the front,<br/>wedged behind the rail, padded off the wall<br/>Phase 2"]
  socket["rail-arm-socket<br/>down the carrier's dovetail;<br/>the arm wedged in it<br/>Phase 2"]
  arm["the arm<br/>a dowel, 550 mm"]
  tip["rail-arm-tip<br/>wedged on the arm's end;<br/>its stem grips the cord<br/>Phase 2"]
  light["the Barrina<br/>hanging inside the shade on its cord"]
  shade["rail-shade<br/>PETG, turned onto the stem's lugs;<br/>10 mm of air round the lamp<br/>Phase 2"]
  planter["a planter adapter<br/>on a second carrier, Later (S16)"]

  wall --> feet --> rail --> carrier --> socket --> arm --> tip --> light
  tip --> shade
  shade --- light
  rail -.-> planter

  classDef planned stroke-dasharray: 5 5
  class tip planned
  class shade planned
  class planter planned
```

## The light's cord

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "The cord is pressed in from the side everywhere it goes, since its plug and timer won't pass a hole. Dashed: planned, labelled with the phase that brings it."
flowchart LR
  socketcord["the socket"] --> stem["up the tip's stem,<br/>gripped · Phase 2"] --> keel["along the tip's keel · Phase 2"]
  keel --> clips["under the arm,<br/>in three clips · Phase 2"] --> joint["round the joint"]
  joint --> behind["down behind the rail,<br/>through each carrier's channel · Phase 2"]
  behind --> foot["the bottom foot's groove · Phase 2"] --> outlet["the outlet"]

  classDef planned stroke-dasharray: 5 5
  class stem planned
  class keel planned
  class clips planned
```
